exposure: Maternal iron-folate supplement intake during pregnancy
finding: Newborn anemia was found to be a moderate public health problem (29.1% prevalence), with maternal anemia, cesarean section delivery, vaginal bleeding during pregnancy, and lack of maternal iron-folate supplementation during pregnancy being significantly associated factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with newborn anemia (AOR: 4.17, 95% CI: 1.89-9.20).
